question:
A series $LCR$ circuit is operated at resonance. It is observed that the rms voltages satisfy $V_L=V_C=2V_R$. The applied rms voltage is $V=100\,\text{V}$ and the average power dissipated in the circuit is $P_{\text{avg}}=250\,\text{W}$.

If the inductance is $L=0.40\,\text{H}$, determine the values of $R$, $C$ and the rms current $I$.

(Assume ideal inductor and capacitor except for the given resistance $R$.)
